system:
You are a promo editor for vertical microdramas (ReelShort/DramaBox style).
You pick which seconds of an episode become a 20-60 second advert for the show.

A good promo:
- opens on a hook: within its first beats, something that stops a scrolling viewer - a slap, a reveal, a shocking line
- ends on a cliffhanger: it stops at an unresolved moment, so the viewer must go find the show
- makes sense alone to someone who has never seen this show

You will be given candidate windows, each a contiguous run of beats labelled [b00], [b01]...
You must choose ONE window and may tighten its edges to any beat labels inside that window.

Reply with JSON only:
{
  "chosen_window": <integer index of the window you picked>,
  "start_beat": "<beat label>",
  "end_beat": "<beat label>",
  "hook_beat": "<beat label, must be at or within 2 beats of start_beat>",
  "cliffhanger_beat": "<beat label, must be at or near end_beat>",
  "hook": "<what grabs the viewer in the first seconds, one sentence>",
  "cliffhanger": "<the unresolved moment it cuts on, one sentence>",
  "hook_type": "<one of: moral outrage, romantic tension, empathy shock, power reversal>",
  "why_it_works": "<one sentence, concrete, no marketing language>",
  "standalone_risk": "<what a new viewer would NOT understand, or 'none'>"
}

Never invent dialogue. Never output a time or a duration - only beat labels.
prompt:
Episode 12. 3 candidate windows, already checked for legal length and real beat boundaries.

--- WINDOW 0 (34 seconds, code score 0.94) ---
[b00] JULIANA (enraged, shouting): "You planted it!"
[b01] ACTION: Juliana lunges a step forward, jabbing an accusing finger toward Gerald.
[b02] CLARISSA (purring, taunting): "Oh, dear sister..."
[b03] CLARISSA (continuing taunt): "...still defending your broken scrap of a man?"
[b04] JULIANA (steely, resolute): "Name your price, Clarissa. I know you."
[b05] CLARISSA (smooth, derisive): "You always were clever, Juliana. Always searching for some way to escape."
[b06] CLARISSA (scheming): "Perhaps I can give you one."
[b07] JULIANA (guarded, cold): "What do you want?"
[b08] CLARISSA (cruel, savoring): "I want to see you crawl, sister."
[b09] CLARISSA (theatrical, vindictive): "My emerald signet ring fell deep into the frozen blackthorn briars at Ashworth Manor. The thorns have grown over it..."
[b10] CLARISSA (chilling, sarcastic): "...sharp as steel. The ground is frozen, like pure ice."
[b11] ACTION: Gerald bursts into a loud, mocking laugh beside the stony Constable.
[b12] CLARISSA (demanding, brutal): "You will retrieve it with your bare hands before the magistrate arrives."

--- WINDOW 1 (22 seconds, code score 0.90) ---
[b00] ACTION: Juliana steps firmly forward, shielding Alexander with her body.
[b01] JULIANA (furious, defiant): "No! That watch was not in his coat!"
[b02] CONSTABLE (blunt, unyielding): "I found it there myself."
[b03] JULIANA (passionate, accusatory): "Then someone put it there!"
[b04] GERALD (smug, condescending): "The proof is in his coat, Juliana. A valuable pocket watch doesn't just walk into a beggar's pocket."
[b05] ALEXANDER (low, steady, dangerous): "I have never touched your property."
[b06] GERALD (mocking, malicious): "Then perhaps your wife should explain why it was found in your coat."
[b07] JULIANA (enraged, shouting): "You planted it!"
[b08] ACTION: Juliana lunges a step forward, jabbing an accusing finger toward Gerald.

--- WINDOW 2 (21 seconds, code score 0.88) ---
[b00] ACTION: Gerald bursts into a loud, mocking laugh beside the stony Constable.
[b01] CLARISSA (demanding, brutal): "You will retrieve it with your bare hands before the magistrate arrives."
[b02] GERALD (gleeful, derisive): "A lady's hands will be shredded to ribbons!"
[b03] CLARISSA (cold, transactional): "Do it, and we withdraw the charges."
[b04] CLARISSA (whispering, menacing): "Fail, or refuse, and your husband hangs from the gallows."
[b05] ACTION: Alexander rests his scarred hand reassuringly on Juliana's shoulder, leaning in toward her.
[b06] ALEXANDER (desperate, protective, urgent): "Juliana, no. Do not let them hurt you. I can handle the law."
[b07] ACTION: Juliana clutches the front of her rustic grey dress, her breathing trembling.
[b08] JULIANA (fierce, emotional, sacrificial): "I am not letting them take you."

Pick the single best promo.
